notes.gloss: covered with or smelling of mold
notes.note: Mold on a thing or in its smell, taken as stale and damp, where *moldy* makes it disgusting.

notes.gloss: a woman of refinement
notes.note: The plainest word for a woman of grace and good manners, and warmer than *gentlewoman*.

notes.gloss: a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
notes.note: Names the idea as something taken in rather than worked out, without *opinion*'s readiness to stand behind it.

notes.gloss: a woman of refinement
notes.note: Stately and formal, it gives a refined woman more weight and dignity than *lady* does.

notes.gloss: an elaborate and systematic plan of action
notes.note: Stresses size and order: a plan with many worked-out parts, more elaborate than a plain *plan*.

notes.gloss: peculiarly fortunate or appropriate; as if by divine intervention
notes.note: Deeply thankful - something so lucky or so fitting is pictured as a gift from above, warmer than *providential*'s sense of a plan.

notes.gloss: made of inferior workmanship and materials
notes.note: Cheap stuff cheaply made, and written off whole as trash, where *shoddy* fixes on poor work passed off as sound.

notes.gloss: causing dejection
notes.note: Dejection by monotony — it flattens rather than darkens, dispiriting without the menace of *grim*.

notes.gloss: a woman of refinement
notes.note: Carries the same respect as *madam* for a refined woman, but said more softly and briefly.

notes.gloss: a woman of refinement
notes.note: It spells out the gentle manners that *lady* only suggests, in a more formal voice.

notes.gloss: a woman of refinement
notes.note: Formal and respectful, it names a refined woman while keeping more distance than *lady*.

notes.gloss: to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth
notes.note: Builds a thing up past its limits or past the truth, the same overreach as *exaggerate* but named with less open blame.

notes.gloss: showing patient and unruffled self-control and restraint under adversity; slow to retaliate or express resentment
notes.note: Calm, patient restraint under hardship or insult alike, in a stiff, bookish word beside the plainer *forbearing*.

notes.gloss: causing or tending to cause anger or resentment
notes.note: The plainer word for what stirs up anger or resentment, or tends to, keeping the shaken-up feel that clinical *agitative* flattens out.

notes.gloss: infinitely wise
notes.note: Wisdom claimed without limit, stated in its most formal form.

notes.gloss: a preset plan of action in team sports
notes.note: A plan set in advance that a sports team runs during a game, far narrower than a *scheme*.

notes.gloss: a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
notes.note: A plan a person or group has chosen and taken on as their own; the stress is on that choice.

notes.gloss: liable to sin
notes.note: Concedes only that sin is possible, not that any has been done, where *sinful* finds the wrong already there.

notes.gloss: a procedure or process for obtaining an objective
notes.note: Puts the weight on method: the steps or process you follow to reach a goal.

notes.gloss: pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
notes.note: Grave and literary - deaths in numbers, or deaths that should not have happened.

notes.gloss: insusceptible of reform
notes.note: States only that reform will not take, a practical verdict without *irredeemable*'s sense of a soul past saving.

notes.gloss: endowed with the capacity to reason
notes.note: Marks a being as able to reason at all - a kind of mind, not a clever one, as in *intelligent life*.

notes.gloss: a vague idea in which some confidence is placed
notes.note: Holds the idea as something sensed inside, with no grounds offered, where *impression* at least implies something was noticed.

notes.gloss: in a more fortunate or prosperous condition
notes.note: Comparative by construction - it always implies something being compared against, and never says what.
